scheme_name: Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession
other_conditions: Applicant must be eligible for or currently receiving a scholarship under the Post‑Matric Scholarship Scheme
Parent or guardian must be engaged in the cleaning or sanitation profession and belong to the scavenger class
If the applicant’s parent is deceased, the eligible guardian must satisfy the cleaning‑profession and scavenger‑class criteria
Eligibility category noted in source: Economically Backward Classes
Eligibility category noted in source: Extremely Backward Classes
benefits_summary: Provides an additional ₹500 per month (up to 10 months a year) to students receiving Post‑Matric scholarships whose parents/guardians work in the cleaning/sanitation sector.
